PictureMatches.explanation: On the left, a picture of this work; on the right, the one you marked in another. The number is how far the likeness is from chance: by chance it comes out around 1, 3 for one work in twenty, 5 for one in a hundred and fifty. ✓ — alike in that sense, ✕ — alike, but not in that sense: the mark takes it into account and becomes more precise.
PictureMatches.heading: Similar to pictures you marked
PictureMatches.likeDrop: Similar to a picture that would make you drop the work
PictureMatches.likePick: Similar to a picture that would make you pick the work
Pictures.explanation: The number on a picture is how many points of your scale it moves the work by: the prediction as it is minus the prediction without it. Mark with 👍 or 👎 a picture that would make you pick the work or drop it — the model will look for similar ones.
Pictures.heading: Pictures
Pictures.influence: The prediction as it is minus the prediction without this picture, in points of your scale
Pictures.notAnalyzedHint: The picture model hasn't analyzed it yet: it doesn't affect the prediction so far
